Magnetic field of a long straight wire, one segment at a time

Animation of the Biot-Savart sum for a long straight wire. A horizontal wire carrying current I to the right is divided into seven segments of length delta x. Point P lies on the y axis a distance d above the wire. For each segment in turn, coloured distinctly, the figure shows the unit vector r-hat from the segment to P, the distance r_i and the angle theta_i between the current direction and r-hat, and then draws that segment's magnetic field contribution at P as an arrow in the segment's colour, pointing out of the page along an obliquely drawn z axis, with its tail on the head of the previous contribution. The contributions from segments near P are longest. After each contribution is drawn, the r-hat, r_i and theta_i annotations fade away and the segment returns to the wire colour, and the next segment is treated the same way. At the end the seven stacked arrows show the total field at P.
